comments.text:
## Issue Analysis

**Root Cause:** This is expected behavior, not a bug. The regression test case is out of date. Since 2025, disabling a feature from another device sends you to the workspace **More features** page instead of showing a not-found page. The redirect is in [`AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx:228-244`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d0ba3f19f60aaf34ee1a2c9cdaf21d9d03b7f145/src/pages/workspace/AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx#L228-L244). That matches what the tester saw ("taken back to workspace setting").

**Recommended Fix:** No App code change. Update the regression test case:
- Step 4: verify you are navigated to the workspace **More features** page.
- Remove steps 5–6 (the not-found page's back button), since that page no longer appears in this flow.

Then close this issue.

<details>
<summary>Investigation details</summary>

**How the behavior changed:**
1. The test steps ("verify a not found page is shown", then "back goes to WS settings") came from [\[HOLD for payment 2024-11-01\] \[$250\] TransitionOD-ND - When disabling tax in OD, ND "page not Found", "Back" takes to WS selection](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/50465), fixed by [Fix going back from workspace not found feature leads to WS list](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/50801) (Oct 2024). At that time a disabled feature rendered the not-found page.
2. [\[Due for payment 2025-05-22\] \[$250\] Tax backwards compatibility - After disable Tax in OD display an it's not here page in ND](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/59076) said the not-found page was wrong. Its expected result is "The Workspace settings should display." [Fix - Tax backwards compatibility - After disable Tax in OD display an it's not here page in ND](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/59565) (May 2025) replaced it with a redirect to More features for all workspace features. Its QA step: "Verify that you are navigated to more features page."
3. [\[Due for payment 2026-01-23\] \[$250\] Workspace setting-Taxes page still shown when disable the taxes from other browser](https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/75861) and [Fix: Taxes page still shown when disable the taxes from other browser](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/76611) (Jan 2026) made the redirect also fire when an RHP is open.
4. [Fix flash of disabled feature page before redirect to More features](https://github.com/Expensify/App/pull/98549) (Aug 2026) shows a loader instead of the disabled page while redirecting ([`AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx:256-260`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d0ba3f19f60aaf34ee1a2c9cdaf21d9d03b7f145/src/pages/workspace/AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx#L256-L260)).

**Current logic:** The not-found page appears only for access problems (no policy access, wrong access variant, missing permission). See [`AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx:225-226`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/d0ba3f19f60aaf34ee1a2c9cdaf21d9d03b7f145/src/pages/workspace/AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx#L225-L226). A disabled feature is no longer part of that condition. It triggers `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures`, which calls `Navigation.goBack(ROUTES.WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES...)`.

**Alternative considered:** The redirect could be accidental. Two separate issues asked for this redirect and approved PRs implemented it, so it is intended.

**Web test:** I enabled Taxes and opened the Taxes page on web. I could not run the two-tab step because the test tool supports one browser tab only. This conclusion rests on code and PR history.

</details>

---
**Next Steps:** If you agree, update the test case and close this issue. If product wants the not-found page back, reply with `@MelvinBot <your feedback>`. That would reverse the decision made in the May 2025 issue above.

comments.author: Abdallah-1551
comments.text:
## Proposal

### Please re-state the problem that we are trying to solve in this issue.
A regression test (https://github.com/Expensify/Expensify/issues/441368) failed on web. A user has a workspace's Taxes page open on one device or tab. The same user disables Taxes from More features on another device. The first device does not show a "not found" page, as the test case expects. It automatically navigates back to the workspace settings (More features) page. The question is whether this is an app bug or an outdated test expectation.

### What is the root cause of that problem?
This is not an app bug. The test case is outdated, and the app is behaving as designed.

- In Oct 2024 (issue #50465, PR #50801), a disabled workspace feature rendered the "not found" page. The regression test was written against that behavior.
- In May 2025 (issue #59076, PR #59565), product decided the not-found page was wrong for this case. The expected result became "The Workspace settings should display." `AccessOrNotFoundWrapper` was changed to redirect to the workspace **More features** page for all workspace features.
- In Jan 2026 (issue #75861, PR #76611), the redirect was extended so it also fires when an RHP is open.
- In Aug 2026 (PR #98549), a loader replaced the brief flash of the disabled page before the redirect.

In the current `src/pages/workspace/AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx`, the not-found condition covers only access problems: no policy access, wrong access variant, or missing permission. A disabled feature is not part of it. A disabled feature instead sets `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures`, which calls `Navigation.goBack(ROUTES.WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES...)`. This matches what the tester saw. Several approved issues and PRs asked for this redirect, so it is not accidental.

### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?
**No App code change.** Reverting would undo the decisions in #59076 and #75861. The fix is to update the regression test case:

1. Change step 4's expected result to: "Verify the user is automatically navigated to the workspace **More features** page, and the Taxes page is no longer shown."
2. Remove the steps that verify the not-found page and its back button (previously steps 5–6). That page no longer appears in this flow. Its back-button behavior was only relevant to #50465.
3. Update the expected-result text in the test management system so future regression runs don't flag this again.
4. Close this issue as "works as designed" and cancel the Upwork job, since there is nothing to implement.

If product explicitly wants the not-found page back, that is a product decision. It would need a new issue reversing #59076, and `AccessOrNotFoundWrapper` would have to stop using `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures` for disabled features.

### What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional)
- **Restore the not-found page for disabled features.** Rejected. It contradicts the product decision in #59076/#59565 and the follow-ups in #75861/#76611. It would also bring back the user-facing problem of seeing an "it's not here" page after a normal settings change.
- **Treat the redirect as an accidental regression and fix it.** Rejected. The PR history shows the redirect was requested and reviewed as intended behavior.

### Testing
No code is changed, so only manual verification is needed:
1. Log in as the same user in two tabs. In Tab A, enable Taxes in a workspace's More features and open the Taxes page.
2. In Tab B, disable Taxes from More features.
3. In Tab A, verify the user is taken to the workspace More features page. There should be no flash of the Taxes page and no not-found page.
4. Repeat with an RHP open in Tab A, and with the ND/OD combination from the report. Verify the same redirect.
5. Check that the not-found page still appears for real access problems, such as a workspace the user can't access or a missing permission. This confirms the wrapper's not-found logic is intact.

Contributor details
Your Expensify account email: camesenin@gmail.com
Upwork Profile Link: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~0170d6b02e9440e604

## Proposal

### Please re-state the problem that we are trying to solve in this issue.
During regression test execution ([Expensify/Expensify#441368](https://github.com/Expensify/Expensify/issues/441368)), when a user is on a workspace's Taxes page in Tab/Device A and disables Taxes in More Features from Tab/Device B, the user is automatically navigated back to the workspace **More features** page instead of rendering a "Not Found" (`PageNotFoundFallback`) screen.

### What is the root cause of that problem?
This is **Expected Behavior (Works As Designed)**. The regression test suite expectation is obsolete and conflicts directly with deliberate product architecture decisions implemented across multiple PRs:

1. **Historical Evolution:**
   - In October 2024 (Issue #50465, PR #50801), disabling a workspace feature initially fell back to the generic `PageNotFoundFallback` screen.
   - In May 2025 (Issue #59076, PR #59565 *"Tax backwards compatibility - After disable Tax in OD display an it's not here page in ND"*), Expensify product determined that displaying an error/404 "Not Found" page to an active workspace admin after modifying a workspace setting was bad UX. Product mandated navigating the user back to the workspace settings (**More Features**) page.
   - In Jan 2026 (Issue #75861, PR #76611), this redirect was reinforced so that it properly handles RHP overlays.
   - In Aug 2026 (PR #98549), a loader was added during the redirect to eliminate any visible flash of the disabled screen.
2. **Current Code Architecture in `src/pages/workspace/AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx:228-260`:**
   ```typescript
   const shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures = isFocused && !isEmptyObject(policy) && !isFeatureEnabled && !(pendingField && !isOffline) && !shouldShowNotFoundPage;

   useEffect(() => {
       if (!shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures) {
           return;
       }
       Navigation.setNavigationActionToMicrotaskQueue(() => {
           Navigation.goBack(ROUTES.WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES.getRoute(policyID));
       });
   }, [shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures]);
   ```
   - `shouldShowNotFoundPage` is explicitly reserved for **access violations** (inaccessible policy, invalid permission, or blocked route).
   - `!isFeatureEnabled` intentionally bypasses the "Not Found" page and triggers `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures`, which renders `FullscreenLoadingIndicator` (to prevent UI flashing, per PR #98549) and navigates back to `WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES`.

### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?

**No App code modification is required or recommended.**

1. **Update Test Management System (TestRail / BrowserStack / GitHub #441368):**
   - **Step 4 Expected Result:** Update from *"A not found page is shown"* to *"User is smoothly redirected back to the workspace More Features page without errors or UI flashing."*
   - **Remove Steps 5 & 6:** Delete verifications testing the "Not Found" page's back button, as that screen is no longer part of the disabled feature UX contract.
2. **Close Issue & Cancel Upwork Bounty:**
   - Close issue #104708 as **Works as Designed / Outdated Regression Test Case**.
   - If Product actively desires to reverse the decisions of PR #59565, PR #76611, and PR #98549 and reinstate a 404 screen when a feature is toggled off, that would constitute a deliberate product redesign requiring a dedicated feature specification.

### What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional)
- **Reverting `AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx` to force `shouldShowNotFoundPage` when `!isFeatureEnabled`:**
  Strongly rejected. This would regress PR #59565, PR #76611, and PR #98549, re-introducing the jarring 404 "Page Not Found" screen for users legitimately toggling features on multi-tab or concurrent admin sessions.

comments.author: khizzcr7
comments.text:
## Proposal

### Please re-state the problem that we are trying to solve in this issue.
Open Workspace > More features > enable Taxes, then open the Taxes page. From a second device, disable Taxes on the More features page. On the first device, the Taxes page should show a "not found" page. Instead, the user is silently bounced back to the workspace settings with no not-found page.

### What is the root cause of that problem?
`WorkspaceTaxesPage.tsx` wraps itself in `AccessOrNotFoundWrapper` with `policyFeature={CONST.POLICY.POLICY_FEATURE.TAXES}`. When the feature flips off mid-session (Pusher policy update from the other device), `isFeatureEnabled` becomes false and `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures` in `AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx` turns true. The redirect effect then calls `Navigation.goBack(ROUTES.WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES.getRoute(policyID))` - but `goBack` with a fallback route pops the current screen back to the previous route in the stack first, and only uses the fallback when there is no history. On web wide layout the taxes screen sits on top of the workspace settings route, so it pops straight back to workspace settings. The user lands on workspace settings (the reported "auto taken back to workspace setting") and neither the More Features page nor a not-found page is ever rendered.

### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?
1. In the `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures` effect in `src/pages/workspace/AccessOrNotFoundWrapper.tsx`, replace `Navigation.goBack(ROUTES.WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES.getRoute(policyID))` with `Navigation.navigate(ROUTES.WORKSPACE_MORE_FEATURES.getRoute(policyID))`, so the user deterministically lands on the More Features page when a feature linked to the current page is disabled - matching the existing design intent in the code comment ("When a workspace feature linked to the current page is disabled we will navigate to the More Features page").
2. Keep the `pendingField` guard as-is so the redirect still does not fire for locally-initiated toggles waiting on a server response.

### What alternative solutions did you explore?
Rendering the full not-found page for a mid-session disable (what the issue's expected result asks for) would contradict the wrapper's existing deliberate design - the comment and the `shouldRedirectToMoreFeatures` flow were built to land on More Features for this exact event. The smaller, design-consistent fix is making the existing redirect actually reach More Features.

I will verify: the exact two-device repro (taxes enabled -> open Taxes -> disable from other device -> land on More Features, not workspace settings); single-device toggle of taxes still works normally; other feature pages using the wrapper (categories, tags, rules) keep their existing behavior; the pendingField case (local toggle awaiting response) does not trigger a redirect.
